claims.target: registered WaterLily flow_16 discrete finite-box primal response directional derivative oracle for canonical v16 SDF

D0_interface_offset.definition: design_mask & unconstrained nodes times cosine taper on abs(phi)<=narrow_band_width_m

D1_filtered_seed11.generator: PCG64 standard normal on canonical point grid
D1_filtered_seed11.post_filter: subtract interface-taper-weighted mean on support, multiply by taper and active design mask, max-absolute normalize

D2_filtered_seed2026.generator: PCG64 standard normal on canonical point grid
D2_filtered_seed2026.post_filter: subtract interface-taper-weighted mean on support, multiply by taper and active design mask, max-absolute normalize

directions.file_encoding: little-endian float32 raw bytes, C order
directions.hash_encoding: SHA-256 of little-endian float32 C-order array bytes

flow_case.candidate_body_mapping: flow_origin + solver_coordinate*flow_spacing; canonical GridSDF retains its registered origin and spacing
flow_case.force_integration_body: canonical v16 candidate GridSDF only; exclude auxiliary moving-ground half-space
flow_case.ground_model: moving planar half-space at solver z=0, mapped to world z=-0.9 m by flow origin, with +x wall velocity 1 m/s
flow_case.native_velocity_boundary: v16_native_far_field_uBC: +x freestream velocity 1 m/s; other normal components zero
flow_case.pressure_boundary: WaterLily projection pressure; no per-patch freestreamPressure input

measurement.endpoint_rule: linearly interpolate from bracketing raw samples at exact window endpoints
measurement.force_closure: total = pressure + viscous on x/y/z; drag=+Fx; downforce=-Fz
measurement.primary_mean: trapezoidal physical-time-weighted mean over exact endpoint-clipped [80,120] tU/L
measurement.runtime_scope: first sim_step! GPU compilation step measured separately; remaining fresh run to tU/L=120 is solver wall time

noise_and_plateau.even_nonlinearity: E=R_plus+R_minus-2*baseline_median; diagnostic only, no gate/Richardson claim

w4_cross_check.interpretation: descriptive cross-check only; preserve the previously registered stop rule if drag sign differs
